summary: Join our Governance in Non-Profit Organizations Training Course to master essential skills and strategies for effective leadership and organizational success.
lede: Governance in non-profit organizations gives leaders a practical framework for making sound decisions, clarifying responsibilities, and keeping the organization focused on its mission. This course helps participants understand the boundaries between board and management while strengthening oversight of strategy, performance, resources, risk, and compliance. Through applied scenarios, participants explore board dilemmas, conflicts of interest, donor requirements, and other oversight challenges. They leave with practical tools, frameworks, and approaches they can bring to their boards, teams, and organizations to build transparency, accountability, and trust.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape or influence governance in non-profit organizations.
audience: Board members and trustees of NGOs, charities
Executive Directors, CEOs, and senior leadership
Governance, risk, and compliance officers in non-profit
Donor relations and grants management professionals
Company secretaries or board support officers
modules: Principles of Governance in Non-Profit Organizations
Governance of Strategy and Organizational Performance
Financial Oversight, Risk Management, and Internal Controls
Working with Donors, Partners, and Key Stakeholders
Ethics, Integrity, and Conflicts of Interest
prerequisites: Participants should have experience in governance, leadership, or management roles within non-profit organizations. Familiarity with organizational structures and board functions is recommended.
